description: This file appears to be a shell script for testing and interacting with SVN repositories and performing Git-SVN operations, focusing on handling of funky or unusual branch names with special characters, percent-encoding, and edge cases.

methods.name: setup svnrepo
methods.description: Sets up a test SVN repository with branches having funky, URL-encoded, or edge case names for testing Git-SVN interactions.

methods.name: test clone with funky branch names
methods.description: Clones the SVN repository via git-svn and verifies the special branch names are correctly mapped and accessible.

methods.name: test dcommit to funky branch
methods.description: Commits changes back to a funky branch using git svn dcommit.

methods.name: test dcommit to scary branch
methods.description: Commits changes to a scary-named branch with special characters.

methods.name: test dcommit to trailing_dotlock branch
methods.description: Commits changes to a branch with a trailing dot lock in its name.
